Bundesliga** (), is a professional association football league in Germany and the highest level of the German football league system. The Bundesliga comprises 18 teams and operates on a system of promotion and relegation with the 2. All Bundesliga clubs "Football club (association football)") take part in the DFB-Pokal cup competition. The winner of the Bundesliga qualifies for the DFL-Supercup. The Bundesliga was founded in 1962 in Dortmund and the first season started in 1963–64. The structure and organisation of the Bundesliga, along with Germany's other football leagues, have undergone frequent changes. The Bundesliga is one of the top national leagues in Europe. Liga (3rd League) in Germany has also been a professional league, but may not be called Bundesliga because the league is run by the German Football Association (DFB) and not, as are the two Bundesligen, by the German Football League (DFL).

title: How does promotion and relegation work in the Bundesliga?
content: **What is the promotion/relegation play-off?**. In Germany, the teams who finish 16th in the Bundesliga and third in Bundesliga 2 contest the promotion/relegation play-off - known in German simply as the *Relegation*. Most years, this means the first leg is played at the home of the Bundesliga side and the second leg is played at the home of the Bundesliga 2 team. The two legs are played following the final matchday of the season, which in 2025/26 fell on Saturday 16 May for the Bundesliga and Sunday 17 May for Bundesliga 2. The first leg at the home of the Bundesliga club (Wolfsburg) was played on Thursday 21 May. The return fixture at the Bundesliga 2 club (Paderborn) was played on Monday 25 May. These dates could have been moved if one or both of the clubs were to be in the DFB Cup final (23 May) or a European final.

title: German Football Promotions & Relegations, 2025-26
content: ## **Here are the German Football Promotions, Relegations & European Places for the 2025-26 season.**. After every season, as it is all over Europe, German football clubs go up, go down, and get into Europe. Meanwhile, here is a post all about promotion and relegation in the top European football leagues. ### **League Structure in German Football**. At the top is the Bundesliga, including all the famous clubs like Bayern Munich, Borussia Dortmund and the rest. Connecting all of this, as in England, is a system of promotion and relegation. At the top of the Bundesliga, as in the Premier League, the top four clubs qualify for the next season’s Champions League. The winner of the domestic cup competition, the DFB-Pokal, also goes to the Europa League — and if that team also qualifies for Champions League or Europa League elsewhere, their spot in Europa goes to the next-highest finisher in the table who didn’t otherwise qualify for Europe.
